description: This file defines the ObsDAO interface, which specifies database operations related to 'Observation' entities within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes method signatures for CRUD operations, querying observations with various filters, and obtaining counts of observations.

classes.name: ObsDAO
classes.description: An interface defining data access methods for Observation entities in the OpenMRS system, including CRUD operations and complex querying capabilities.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves an Observation object to the database.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves an Observation by its unique ID.

methods.name: deleteObs
methods.description: Deletes a given Observation from the database.

methods.name: getObservations
methods.description: Fetches a list of observations based on various filters such as person, encounter, concept, location, date range, etc.

methods.name: getObservationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of observations matching specified filters.

methods.name: getObsByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an Observation entity by its UUID.

methods.name: getRevisionObs
methods.description: Fetches previous revision of an observation, if any.

methods.name: getSavedStatus
methods.description: Obtains the current saved status of an observation, bypassing caches.
